description: The line plot illustrates the WikiText validation perplexity of three language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—after being pruned at 70% sparsity using the OWL method, with results plotted against the parameter M ranging from 3 to 8 on the x-axis. The y-axis represents perplexity values from 20.0 to 40.0. The blue line with triangular markers, representing Vicuna-7B, starts at approximately 41.0 at M=3, declines sharply to a minimum of 30.0 at M=7, and then rises slightly to 39.0 at M=8. The green line with circular markers, corresponding to LLaMA1-7B, begins at 28.0 at M=3, decreases to a minimum of 24.0 at M=5, and then increases steadily to 36.0 at M=8. The orange line with star markers, representing LLaMA1-13B, starts at 20.0 at M=3, decreases to a minimum of 14.0 at M=6, and stabilizes at 20.0 by M=8. Across all values of M, LLaMA1-13B consistently achieves the lowest perplexity, indicating superior performance, while Vicuna-7B exhibits the highest perplexity throughout the tested range.
caption_used: WikiText validation perplexity of LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B pruned by various M at 70% sparsity using OWL. The perplexity values are plotted against M, ranging from 3 to 8 on the x-axis, with the y-axis representing perplexity values from 20.0 to 40.0. Vicuna-7B (blue line with triangular markers) exhibits a sharp decline from approximately 41.0 at M=3 to a minimum of 30.0 at M=7, followed by a slight increase to 39.0 at M=8. LLaMA1-7B (green line with circular markers) starts at a perplexity of 28.0 at M=3, reaches a minimum of 24.0 at M=5, and increases steadily to 36.0 at M=8. LLaMA1-13B (orange line with star markers) begins at 20.0 at M=3, decreases to a minimum of 14.0 at M=6, and stabilizes at 20.0 by M=8. LLaMA1-13B consistently outperforms the other models across all values of M, with Vicuna-7B showing the highest perplexity throughout the range.
